narr: Warm air advection above a cooler airmass generated elevated thunderstorms. Training of storms led to locally heavy rainfall and minor flooding.

lsr: THE ATASCOSA COUNTY SHERIFFS OFFICE REPORTS FARM TO MARKET ROAD 791 IS CLOSED AND IMPASSABLE AT THE INTERSECTION OF COUNTY ROAD 445 DUE TO WATER OVER THE ROADWAY.
